001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
004import org.bukkit.command.CommandSender;
005import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
007import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
008
009/**
010 * Utility used for shop price validating
011 */
012public interface PriceLimiter {
013
014  /**
015   * Check the price restriction rules
016   *
017   * @param sender   the sender
018   * @param stack    the item to check
019   * @param currency the currency
020   * @param price    the price
021   *
022   * @return the result
023   */
024  @NotNull
025  PriceLimiterCheckResult check(@NotNull CommandSender sender, @NotNull ItemStack stack, @Nullable String currency, double price);
026
027  /**
028   * Check the price restriction rules
029   *
030   * @param user     the user
031   * @param stack    the item to check
032   * @param currency the currency
033   * @param price    the price
034   *
035   * @return the result
036   */
037  @NotNull
038  PriceLimiterCheckResult check(@NotNull QUser user, @NotNull ItemStack stack, @Nullable String currency, double price);
039}
